## Constant and field details

<a id="ExpoTweenEquation-constant-IN"></a>

### IN

`ExpoTweenEquation IN` 

Starts slowly, along an exponential.

<a id="ExpoTweenEquation-constant-OUT"></a>

### OUT

`ExpoTweenEquation OUT`

<a id="ExpoTweenEquation-constant-IN_OUT"></a>

### IN_OUT

`ExpoTweenEquation IN_OUT`
